title: Transition Oracle Component
statement: For every finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$, bit strings $x$ and $\beta$, and natural numbers $u,v,s$, the fifth oracle component on the encoded input consisting of $x$, $\beta$, and the binary representations of $u,v,s$ returns true exactly when there is a valid one-step transition of $N$ on input $x$ from a configuration of code $u$ to a configuration of code $v$, with both configurations confined to the radius-$s$ work-tape window.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
